question: Pradhan Mantri Rojgar Protsahan Yojana is being implemented since ______.
solution:
The correct answer is __**2016**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• **Pradhan Mantri Rojgar Protsahan Yojana (PMRPY)** was launched in **2016** by the Government of India.
 
• The primary objective of the scheme is to **promote employment generation** by providing incentives to employers for generating new employment.
 
• Under PMRPY, the government pays the employer's contribution of 8.33% towards the Employees' Pension Scheme (EPS) for new employees for the first three years of their employment.
 
• This scheme aims to provide social security benefits and encourage employers to hire more workers in the formal sector.
 
• PMRPY is applicable to all sectors, with special focus on the manufacturing and service sectors.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Pradhan Mantri Shram Yogi Maan-Dhan (PM-SYM)**

 
 
• Launched in 2019, PM-SYM is a pension scheme for unorganized workers to ensure old age protection.
 
• It provides a minimum assured pension of ₹3000 per month after the age of 60 years.
 
• The scheme is available to workers in the age group of 18-40 years with a monthly income of ₹15,000 or less.
 
• The Life Insurance Corporation (LIC) of India manages the fund and pension payouts.
 
 
 
• **Pradhan Mantri Jeevan Jyoti Bima Yojana (PMJJBY)**
 
 
• Launched in 2015, PMJJBY is a life insurance scheme providing a life cover of ₹2 lakhs for a premium of ₹436 per annum.
 
• It is available to individuals aged 18-50 years with a bank account.
 
• The cover is for one year, renewable from year to year.
 
 
 
• **Pradhan Mantri Suraksha Bima Yojana (PMSBY)**
 
 
• Launched in 2015, PMSBY is an accidental insurance scheme providing a cover of ₹2 lakhs for accidental death and full disability.
 
• It is available to individuals aged 18-70 years with a bank account for a premium of ₹12 per annum.
 
• The cover is for one year, renewable from year to year.
 
 
 
• **Ayushman Bharat - Pradhan Mantri Jan Arogya Yojana (AB-PMJAY)**
 
 
• Launched in 2018, AB-PMJAY is the world's largest government-funded health assurance scheme.
 
• It provides health cover of ₹5 lakhs per family per year for secondary and tertiary care hospitalization.
 
• The scheme targets more than 10 crore poor and vulnerable families (approximately 50 crore beneficiaries).
